name: Design of Turbomachinery
description: Introduction, velocity diagrams, fundamental laws of fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and compressible flow, and definitions of efficiency. Two-dimensional cascade analysis. Analysis and design of axial-flow turbines and compressors, centrifugal pumps, fans, compressors, and hydraulic turbines. Three-dimensional analysis of axial turbomachines. Combustion systems. Mechanical design of turbomachines.
